quarterly_data.quarter: Cloudflare press release: Cloudflare Helps End the Search-or-AI-Training Tradeoff (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cloudflare launched Disallow AI Training (refuse AI training while staying in search) and an Accountable designation for AI crawling, replacing its Block AI Bots switch with separate controls for search, AI training and AI agents and Managed Robots.txt with Bot Preference Sync; Apple, Google and Microsoft are labelled Accountable, and other mixed-use crawlers are blocked when site owners block training. Cloudflare says mixed-use crawlers make up 36.6% of verified crawler traffic on its network, fewer than 1% of sites block search crawlers and 17% restrict AI training.
quarterly_data.figure: mixed-use crawlers 36.6% of verified crawler traffic; 17% of sites restrict AI training
